essence: The mantra's sage is Brahmā, its meter is nivṛt, and its goddess is Gaurī.
The prescribed meditation presents the goddess facing east with eight hands, articulated through rudra-syllables.
The visualization depicts the goddess as red-anointed, world-adored, and clothed in safflower-red garments.
The declared worship sequence includes the world-guardians and their weapons.
The fire oblation should be performed with sesame and rice grains mixed with the three sweets.
